messages:
Maria Chen: Thinking out loud — I want to propose a capability-driven verticalization instead of the current transport-slice approach. Split by capability (routing, enrichment, quota, telemetry) so teams own a cohesive surface.

Benefits: clearer ownership, per-capability scaling, easier targeted debt paydown.

Proposal (staircase migration):
1) Thin adapter facade around the monolith exposing the same public contract.
2) Move non-critical enrichment paths into vertical services behind the adapter.
3) Migrate routing core and quota next (higher risk).
4) Deprecate monolith once traffic is routed to verticals.

Questions: what do we do about KV/prefix cache ownership? How to version contracts? What are SLO impacts?

Example shim snippet:```js
// adapter: translate old request -> vertical
function adapt(req) { return { capability: req.type, payload: req.body }; }
```

Jorge Alvarez: +1 to the general approach. Quick Q on cache: if each vertical keeps its own local KV cache we risk duplication and stale entries. Can we centralize reads with a hot-path cache service and allow writes to be owned by verticals? Also need a clear contract versioning strategy (semver-ish) so adapters can translate v1->v2.

Ash Patel: Love the staircase idea. Recommend feature-flagged rollout per-tenant: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error/latency regressions. Put strict throttles on verticals during the early steps. For contracts: semantic version + compatibility adapters, keep old endpoint for minimum N months.

Lin Zhao: We'll need end-to-end integration tests that simulate mixed-path traffic (some requests hit monolith, some verticals). Also add synthetic load jobs to exercise KV cache under realistic QPS. Obs: create metrics `vertical_migration_error_rate` and `vertical_migration_p99` and wire them to a temporary dashboard + alert policy.

OpsBot: Deploy plan stub created: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/verticalization-step1 (internal). Canary tooling: /deploy/canary will handle gradual traffic shift. Suggested maintenance window: Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC.

Maria Chen: Awesome, thanks. Action items: Jorge to propose cache ownership pattern by EOD Fri, Ash to draft rollout toggles + canary thresholds, Lin to stub metrics + test harness, I'll update the RFC with the staircase migration plan.

We'll sync Thu sync 10:00am. If anyone's blocked please react or DM. :thumbsup:
